purpose: Teach: 差益/守秘/ターボ/コストダウン/返上/行革/株券/引渡し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、為替差益の計上を確認しろ
lines.en: Make sure we account for the foreign exchange gains.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Each syllable lands with precision. No warmth, no softness—expectation of instant compliance. Slight forward lean from the desk.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に守秘義務を改めて徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll reinforce the confidentiality obligations with the team right away.
lines.style: Respectful and measured. Immediate acknowledgment—no hesitation. Calm, steady voice. Shoulders squared. This is a man who documents his promises internally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業務をターボのように加速しろ
lines.en: I want this company moving faster. Accelerate operations now.
lines.style: Sharp attack on the first word. Impatient tempo. Each directive lands like a drumbeat. The tone of someone who has already moved on to the next five things.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取引のコストダウン案を準備しました
lines.en: Understood. I've prepared a cost reduction plan for new client contracts.
lines.style: Steady, factual report. Pride in the work—not boastful, just honest. Even pace. A quick nod of readiness at the end, as if presenting something already done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様の信頼回復のため汚名を返上しろ
lines.en: We need to restore our reputation with key clients. Clear this stigma completely.
lines.style: Firmer intensity. The word 'stigma' lands with weight—there's real concern beneath the directive. Controlled but purposeful. A moment of silence baked into the delivery, as if the gravity of the situation settles.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内行革を断行する所存です
lines.en: Understood. I'm committed to implementing internal reforms without delay.
lines.style: Formal respect mixed with quiet determination. Slightly slower pace on the commitment—it's personal now. Hands steady on the desk. This is not a casual promise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、株券電子化の対応を進めろ
lines.en: Push forward on our stock certificate digitization. Make it happen.
lines.style: Efficient, expecting completion. No elaboration needed—this is the next operational milestone. Brisk rhythm. The tone of someone already thinking about what comes after.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への商品引渡し日を確定しました
lines.en: Understood. I've confirmed the delivery date with our key clients.
lines.style: Final report—assured and complete. Voice settles into a lower register, signaling closure. Quiet confidence. A soft exhale before standing, as if one item has been fully resolved.
